description:
jamovi is an advanced, real-time, statisticial spreadsheet, providing a
suite of common statistical methods such as descriptives, t-tests, ANOVAs,
correlation matrices, proportion tests, contingency tables, and factor
analysis.

Additional analyses are available from the jamovi library.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
